svg.title: A seasonal expected band catches incidents that a rolling z-score confuses with the daily cycle
svg.desc: Three days of 5-minute TaskFlow API request counts, Thursday 15 to Saturday 17 October 2026, on a scale from 0 to 2,400. A green band shows the expected range for each 5-minute slot: the median of the same slot in a normal week plus or minus five robust standard deviations for that hour, so it is narrow at night and wide in the afternoon. The traffic line stays inside the band except during two incidents, which the seasonal robust z-score flags with red dots: a partial outage on Thursday at 11:00, when requests drop to about a third, and bot traffic on Saturday at 03:00, when night traffic triples. At night the band is so narrow that tripled traffic stands out, although 500 requests would be ordinary in the afternoon.
